--- 命令 ---
echo "===== 升级黑匣子v2.1(加连接探针+环境指纹) 287339 $(date '+%F %T') ====="
echo "[1]写新脚本:"
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /root/offline_watch_v2.sh
chmod +x /root/offline_watch_v2.sh
bash -n /root/offline_watch_v2.sh && echo "  语法OK md5=$(md5sum /root/offline_watch_v2.sh|cut -c1-8)" || { echo "  语法失败中止"; exit 1; }
cp /root/offline_watch_v2.sh /root/offline_watch.sh
echo "[2]停旧→自检(验证新采集节+推送)→拉起:"
pkill -f 'bash /root/offline_watch.sh' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'bash /root/offline_watch_v2.sh' 2>/dev/null; sleep 2
rm -rf /root/.offline_watch_v2.lock 2>/dev/null
OW_SELFTEST=1 bash /root/offline_watch_v2.sh
sleep 3
echo "  取证报告节标题:"; grep "----" /root/offline_forensics.log | tail -10
echo "  环境指纹:"; grep -A8 "⑦ 环境指纹" /root/offline_forensics.log | tail -9
echo "[3]拉起主进程:"
rm -rf /root/.offline_watch_v2.lock 2>/dev/null
( setsid nohup bash /root/offline_watch.sh >> /root/offline_watch2.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & )
sleep 3
pgrep -af 'offline_watch' | head -2 || echo "  未拉起!"
echo "[4]确认自启守卫仍在:"
grep -c 'offline_watch.sh' /root/remote_ctl_v6.sh /root/start_all.sh 2>/dev/null
echo "=====完====="
